subject: What is the best way to add a javascript in shiny when DOM is already loaded?

messages.author: 1d4b6bcd63443185
messages.subject: What is the best way to add a javascript in shiny when DOM is already loaded?
parts:
Hi all, I have a doubt about what is the best way to add a javascript that load when DOM is already loaded?

I want to enable the option "autoclose" in datepicker. I saw the change to enable noConflict mode ( https://github.com/rstudio/shiny/commit/f87506e2e7bc9d8ca250d40d11c3dc62068a8dda ) and with this change, likely this should be as:

$(document).ready(function(){
$('#reportdate input').bootstrapDP({
 autoclose: true
}
});

I am loading this js using:
includeScript("./www/js/filters.js"),



But this seem that load when the datepicker library was not loaded. I saw differents options: to use shinyjs, to use javascript events in shiny and messages in javascript, etc.

But what is the best way? How can I modify DOM with JS when DOM is all loaded?

Thanks in advance!

messages.author: c1629c4c1cffcc0e
messages.subject: Re: What is the best way to add a javascript in shiny when DOM is already loaded?
parts:
Hello Pablo —

What we do for our Shiny apps is we create an htmlOutput() that receives the JS raw script (text) as HTML() after every necessary part is loaded.

Create the output object with req(), and then place all of the date inputs you are creating with datepicker within that req() function.  That way, the JS will not output the JS until all of those datepicker inputs specified within req() have been created.

I’m not a pro at this, so there is probably a better way.  But that should get you on a start.

~ Laz Peterson
Paravis, LLC

messages.subject: Re: What is the best way to add a javascript in shiny when DOM is already loaded?
parts:
Hi guys, sorry by the delay, I found my problem, my autoclose was working (using the includescript()) in shiny 0.13 with:
$(document).ready(function(){

    $('#test input').datepicker({
        autoclose: true
    });
});
and loading the script:
  div(
    column(6, checkboxInput(idcheckbox, labelcheckbox, FALSE)),
    column(6, dateInput(idinputdate, label = labelinputdate)),
    includeScript("./www/js/commonfilters.js")
  )


In shiny 0.14.2, I need to use bsDatepicker() :
$(document).ready(function(){

    $('#test input').bsDatepicker({
        autoclose: true
    });
});

And all is working.


Joe / Laz Thank you very much for your time.
@Laz, I will have in mind your method for others options.
